dimensions.assessment: Affects community health centers nationwide and patients relying on them for primary and behavioral healthcare services.
dimensions.evidence: require community health centers to provide behavioral and mental health and substance use disorder services

dimensions.assessment: Broadens required service offerings for community health centers to include mental health and substance use disorder care backed by substantial dedicated funding.
dimensions.evidence: behavioral and mental health and substance use disorder services

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $700 million in federal funding for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031 to be transferred to the Secretary of Health and Human Services.
dimensions.evidence: $700,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Public Health Service Act and the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act to alter the statutory service requirements of community health centers.
dimensions.evidence: Section 330(b)(1)(A)(i) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 254b(b)(1)(A)(i)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanently amends community health center service obligations while providing a five-year dedicated funding stream spanning fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031

missing_information: Specific administrative guidelines on how health centers must implement the newly required behavioral health services.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates that community health centers provide behavioral, mental health, and substance use disorder services as part of their required primary health services and provides $700 million in annual funding for fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
